label: FICTION. Six invented practice profiles. Every 'evidence assumption' below was written to exercise the method. None was observed anywhere, and none describes the University of Iowa.

evidence_assumptions.statement: A written standard requires peer review before merge
evidence_assumptions.basis: ASSUMED for this worked example. Modelled on the kind of document an engagement would request; no such document was read.

evidence_assumptions.statement: One repository shows a branch rule requiring a review
evidence_assumptions.basis: ASSUMED. One repository's configuration, which is an instance and not a pattern.

profiles.capacity_note: Two engineers available for improvement work alongside delivery.

evidence_assumptions.statement: A published standard requires an annual privileged-access review
evidence_assumptions.basis: ASSUMED. A policy stating an intent; no review record is assumed to exist.

profiles.capacity_note: One part-time reviewer; no dedicated security engineering capacity.

evidence_assumptions.statement: A procedure requires two approvals for production deployment
A sample of changes over one month shows approvals recorded on each
evidence_assumptions.basis: ASSUMED. Repeated instances across a window, which is what separates level 4 from level 3.

profiles.capacity_note: Shared platform team; deployment tooling is centrally operated.

evidence_assumptions.statement: One team records a reviewer sign-off on an AI-assisted output
evidence_assumptions.basis: ASSUMED. A single instance: it happened once, which is not the same as it repeats.

evidence_assumptions.statement: One quarterly review is recorded in a spreadsheet

profiles.capacity_note: Three owners across three separate spreadsheets.
